name: x-companion-tests
description: Live tests for the x-companion plugin. harness.spec.ts drives GET /harness in a real browser; the PHP suites run with the system php. Playwright is normally resolved out of tools/node_modules (proof/lib/env.mjs does that on purpose, so one browser download serves the whole repo) — the dependency is declared here for anyone running this directory on its own. Keep the version pinned: 1.60.0 is the release whose Chromium build is already cached on the development machine.
